programs.title: Man on Fire
programs.desc: American John Creasy (Denzel Washington) is a man haunted by nightmares from his past.He is a former assassin who worked for the CIA for many years.Frustrated, he avoids people and seeks solace in alcohol.Creasy comes to Mexico to visit his old friend and colleague, Rayburn (Christopher Walken).The city is currently gripped by a wave of kidnappings for ransom.Rich residents panic and many of them hire security guards to ensure the safety of their children.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).At first, Creasy has a hard time coping with the girl's presence.Over time, however, he becomes friends with her.Under its influence, he changes his attitude to life and gives up alcohol.Soon, however, little Pita is kidnapped.The desperate man does everything to save her.

programs.title: The Emoji Movie
programs.desc: Millions of smartphones around the world have an application for sending messages through which you can communicate your feelings and moods.This is where the city of Textopolis, where emotes live, is hidden.The task of each of them is to express a different state of mind.The exception is Minek, who can express every emotion.However, he dreams of being like others.Together with Piątek and the superhacker Matrix, they set off on a journey through the phone in search of a solution.The animated film is directed by Tony Leondis ("Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters").The Polish language version featured, among others: Paweł Ciołkosz, Szymon Roszak, Monika Pikuła and Katarzyna Kwiatkowska.

programs.title: Adult Best Friends
programs.desc: Katie (Katie Corwin) and Delaney (Delaney Buffett), who have known each other since childhood, are best friends.They cannot live without each other, even though each of them is at a different stage of their lives.While the first woman is ready to start a family, which was preceded by accepting the proposal of her boyfriend, John (Mason Gooding), the second one stopped at the college stage and has no intention of growing up.In addition, Delaney does not like her friend's lover because she is convinced that sooner or later their relationship will suffer because of him.Therefore, Katie, who always takes into account her friend's opinion, decides to tell her about the engagement in the most delicate way possible, during a girls' trip together.Unfortunately, nothing goes according to plan during the trip.Katie Corwin and Delaney Buffett, who play the main characters, and who also co-wrote the film's script, are also considered best friends in real life.

programs.title: L'amica geniale 4
programs.desc: 1980s.Social unrest is growing in Italy.Elena and Lila, now adults, live in the same neighborhood again.Women struggle with the difficulties of motherhood and professional work.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programs.desc: The inhabitants of the island of Berk engage in fishing, sheep breeding and fighting dragons that regularly devastate their settlement.Frail Hiccup, the son of the tribe's chieftain, has no warrior's soul.He is a designer and inventor.However, he wants to be as good as his heroic father and, together with his peers, he takes part in classes on taming winged creatures.One day, using a launcher he constructed, he injures a representative of a rare species, a Night Fury.But no one believes him.The boy cannot kill a helpless creature.She secretly begins to care for him.She also names him Toothless.Over time, they become friends.The teenager decides to bring harmony between humans and dragons.Animation from the creators of "Shrek" and "Kung Fu Panda" nominated for two Oscars.A well-thought-out plot, excellent music and great Polish dubbing are the advantages of this wise story for the whole family.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
programs.desc: A grave danger looms over Berk.The unexpected appearance of a wild and elusive dragon coincides with the darkest period in the history of the settlement.Toothless loses his head for a beautiful creature.However, he does not realize that it hides a dangerous secret.She is followed by someone who intends to trap all the dragons.The enemy threatens the inhabitants of a land where flying creatures and people live in harmony with each other.The young Viking Hiccup and his friend set off on an adventurous journey.Daredevils search for the hidden world of legends.During the expedition, two different races unite to fight for what is most precious to them.The last part of the film trilogy based on the books by Cressida Cowell.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Julia Kamińska, Wojciech Machnicki, Sebastian Cybulski and Tomasz Traczyński.

programs.title: One of Them Days
programs.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.

programs.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programs.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programs.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programs.desc: London, 1970.Farrokh "Freddie" Bulsara (Rami Malek) works at Heathrow Airport.One day he meets Mary Austin (Lucy Boynton), who becomes his girlfriend.He also meets members of the band Smile - drummer Roger Taylor (Ben Hardy) and guitarist Brian May (Gwilym Lee).The musicians are looking for a new vocalist.It becomes Freddie.Additionally, bassist John Deacon (Joe Mazzello) joins the group.Some time later they record their debut album.Soon, Freddie changes the band's name to Queen and his surname to Mercury.The artists come under the wing of manager John Reid (Aidan Gillen) and release a new album, and then go on tour around the United States.Even though Freddie proposes to Mary, during the trip he begins to question his own sexuality.In 1975, the album "A Night at the Opera" was released, which included, among others:the song "Bohemian Rhapsody".The composition becomes the reason for the breakup with the current manager, but also makes the musicians real stars.

programs.title: Insecure
programs.desc: The further fate of Issa Dee, a young African-American woman living in Los Angeles.An insecure girl tries to live her own life.He is friends with lawyer Molly.Their relationship is going through a crisis.
